i.norm: Tests that a {@link LineIterator} backed by a {@link BufferedReader} honors a custom {@link LineIterator#isValidLine(String)} filter, skipping the lines the filter rejects.
Total number of lines written to the test file: "LINE 0" .. "LINE 8".
Number of lines the filter keeps. The filter drops every line whose trailing digit {@code d} satisfies {@code d % 3 == 1}, i.e. lines ending in 1, 4 and 7. That removes 3 of the 9 lines, leaving 6.

Iterates over {@code reader} with a {@link LineIterator} whose {@code isValidLine} filter keeps only the lines whose trailing digit {@code d} satisfies {@code d % 3 != 1}, then verifies that:
  • {@code remove()} is unsupported,
  • exactly the un-filtered lines are returned in order, and
  • iterating past the end throws {@link NoSuchElementException}.
Walk the expected lines, skipping the indices the filter rejects (idx % 3 == 1).
